warnings.warning: Section 6.2 computes all-assets as good, some-assets as excellent, and vessels as average, but Section 6.3 reverses the first two labels while recommending partial relocation.
The printed SST code contains 'sum(isnan(series))' without a visible conditional keyword, so the displayed program is not syntactically reproducible as printed.
The SST output declares a 100-step time dimension while the printed assignment supplies only 1970:2019, leaving the historical-plus-forecast calendar inconsistent.
The order-50 predictor appears to be estimated from only 50 annual observations, leaving no clear residual degrees of freedom and making the Toeplitz system vulnerable to ill-conditioning.
The 2016-2019 inspection may reuse years included in coefficient estimation, so Table 4 is not proven to be an out-of-sample backtest.
Forecast noise is sampled only as a positive addition and threshold rejection selectively redraws paths, which can manufacture an upward trend beyond the fitted predictor.
Equation 17 prints 99.37 percent for a three-sigma interval; the standard normal mass within plus or minus three sigma is approximately 99.73 percent.
Equation 23 describes a ratio of normal-density values, while the appendix new_num implementation uses normcdf ratios, so equation and code do not implement the same capacity rule.
move_num receives a scalar population, so length(pos_curr) equals one and the loop can move at most one unit to each neighbor rather than sampling from the whole population.
next_state adds migrants to destinations but overwrites the source using reproduction from the original population, so outgoing migration is not visibly conserved.
The appendix does not visibly implement the claimed 1000-run outer experiment or its first-inaccessible-year stopping rule, preventing code-to-Table-6 parity.
The paper treats a one-degree grid as roughly 70-100 km, although longitude width varies with latitude and differs from latitude width; the access boundary is anisotropic.
The fuzzy weight vector and judgment matrices have no documented elicitation sample, consistency procedure, measurement scale, or uncertainty analysis.
Figure 12 treats disappearance beyond the plotted map extent as movement into another country's territorial waters, but map extent is not a legal maritime boundary.
The sensitivity analysis perturbs only linear-predictor coefficients and does not propagate uncertainty through species matching, CA timing, or fuzzy strategy ranking.

global_organization_chain: Summary compresses the full route: ocean warming -> gridded SST forecast -> species locations -> access-loss timing -> fuzzy strategy -> local sensitivity -> magazine translation (page 1).
Background narrows the global mechanism to Scottish herring, mackerel, and small fishing companies, then names prediction and adaptation as the linked problem (page 3).
The work preview and task list split the route into five inspectable deliverables before any formula is introduced (pages 3-4).
Four assumptions authorize a temperature-directed, Gaussian-tolerance, logistic-growth, trend-continuation model while also defining its transfer boundary (page 4).
Notation establishes prediction-error, thermal, population, and fuzzy-decision symbols before the corresponding equations and matrices (page 4).
Historical gridded SST is sampled annually, inspected in the frequency domain, and smoothed so the predictor consumes a declared signal (pages 5-6).
Moving-average, linear-prediction, autocorrelation, and Levinson-Durbin blocks produce a 2020-2069 SST field and a four-year internal error table (pages 6-9).
Observed 2012 fish markers supply thermal intervals that are matched against forecast cells to generate multi-year likely-location maps (pages 9-10).
Gaussian preference, logistic reproduction, temperature-scaled capacity, and a Moore-neighborhood CA turn cell temperatures into annual fish-population fields (pages 11-15).
Repeated CA experiments convert movement beyond a one-grid company-access boundary into best, worst, and modal elapsed years (page 15).
Five economic factors, three baseline options, one weight vector, and three judgment matrices turn the ecological result into baseline membership ratings (pages 16-18).
A foreign-water scenario changes weights and matrices, then introduces fish processing as a fourth strategy when the original options are judged insufficient (pages 19-21).

A coefficient perturbation table supplies a narrow stability check; strengths and limitations then separate reusable structure from unresolved ecological, spatial, and subjective inputs (pages 21-22).
The conclusion restates the physical-to-decision route, while the magazine article reorders the same evidence into accessible maps, timing, and action advice (pages 22, 24-25).
References and MATLAB appendices expose provenance and implementation details so formula, code, and claim parity can be checked in the final warning pass (pages 22-23, 26-32).

main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Identify where fishing access is likely to move under the paper's temperature-only proxy.

main_argument_chains.claim: Thermal preference and logistic reproduction can be coupled in a cellular automaton to estimate fish movement and population.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Create annual fish fields consumed by the company-access stopping rule.

main_argument_chains.claim: A five-factor fuzzy evaluation can compare three baseline adaptation strategies.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Rank all-assets relocation, partial relocation, and vessel deployment within the elicited preference scenario.

main_argument_chains.claim: Loss of fish to waters outside the modeled domain changes the strategy evaluation and motivates a processing option.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Escalate from partial relocation to vessels and fish processing under the paper's jurisdiction scenario.

main_argument_chains.claim: The paper provides internal checks for forecast error, repeated simulation, preference scenarios, and coefficient perturbation.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Retain these as bounded internal checks rather than external validation of the full pipeline.

main_argument_chains.claim: The same technical evidence can be reordered for a fishery audience without deleting quantities or caveats.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Deliver an accessible magazine article that remains traceable to the technical body.
